offers_products.reason: It sells natural gas as a commodity and solar-generated energy, and also sells HVAC equipment through Home Services.

offers_services.reason: NJNG gas distribution utility service, plus pipeline and storage services and HVAC installation and repair.

sells_to_consumers.reason: NJNG serves residential gas customers, and Home Services sells to homeowners.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial gas customers, electric generators, wholesale marketers and distributors buy gas, storage and transportation.

recurring_revenue.reason: Gas utility customers buy continuously, and it also has service plans and storage and transport contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Customers need natural gas for heating and utility service, which is regulated and hard to cut in a recession.

big_ticket.reason: Main sales are monthly gas utility bills and routine service; occasional HVAC installs are a smaller part.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from pipelines, storage and distribution networks, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: New Jersey Natural Gas serves mostly households and small businesses; large wholesale customers are the smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Gas distribution pipelines, Leaf River storage, Adelphia pipeline and solar projects need heavy ongoing capital investment.

notes: I judged by NJNG, the principal subsidiary, as the larger part of the business.
